approval_basis: Explicit human instructions to finalize the first-dataset-slice contract and approve texture-agnostic rendering on 2026-09-14.
ground_truth_authority: Blender-derived evaluated camera and geometry state

semantic_baseline.rule: Named semantic categories are outside this contract and must not be inferred.

render_resource_policy.readiness_rule: zero unresolved resources required by the approved render policy

requirements: is render-enabled in the evaluated scene
has a finite evaluated world-space bounding box
excluded: objects excluded from render by object, collection, or view-layer state

camera_relative_coordinate_frame.z_axis: camera local -Z; positive is forward from the camera

object_anchor.definition: arithmetic mean of the eight evaluated local bounding-box corners after transformation by object.matrix_world
invalid_when: any transformed corner or anchor component is non-finite
camera-relative anchor z is not strictly positive

distance.definition: Euclidean distance from camera optical center to object_anchor
distance.serialization: round to nine decimal places using round-half-even; normalize negative zero to zero

relations.pair_requirements: both objects must be visible eligible task objects
relations.deadband_behavior: if the relevant absolute axis delta is less than or equal to relation_deadband_m, invalidate that relation task with relation_within_deadband

visibility_definition.sampling_grid: one camera ray through every final-resolution pixel center
visibility_definition.geometry: evaluated render-enabled geometry in the active view layer
visibility_definition.visible_pixel: the object's evaluated surface is the nearest ray hit, within ray_hit_distance_epsilon_m
visibility_definition.visible_object: visible_pixel_count is greater than or equal to 16
visibility_definition.total_projected_pixel_count: pixel-center rays that hit the target when all other eligible occluding geometry is omitted from the visibility query

occlusion_states.fully_occluded: total_projected_pixel_count is positive and visible_pixel_count equals 0
occlusion_states.partially_occluded: visible_pixel_count is positive and less than total_projected_pixel_count

visibility_definition.unsupported_material_behavior: If alpha blending, holdout, transmission, refraction, or another material effect makes geometric first-hit visibility disagree with the rendered observation, invalidate the sample with unsupported_photometric_visibility.

tie_breaking.nearest_object: All objects within distance_tie_epsilon_m of the minimum form the tie set; select the lexicographically smallest instance_id and record the sorted tie_instance_ids.
tie_breaking.collection_order: Sort instance IDs lexicographically; sort relation records by relation, subject_instance_id, object_instance_id.
tie_breaking.ray_hit: Hits within ray_hit_distance_epsilon_m are ordered by lexicographic instance_id and the selected ID is recorded.

tasks.canonical_answer: lexicographically sorted array of visible instance_ids
selected instance_id, distance_m, and sorted tie_instance_ids
boolean relation result for the ordered subject/object pair
boolean relation result for the ordered subject/object pair
boolean relation result for the ordered subject/object pair
boolean relation result for the ordered subject/object pair

valid_sample_conditions: source and derived-scene checksums match metadata provenance
the stable-ID registry matches the evaluated scene with exactly 2777 unique IDs
the selected camera is one of the 29 eligible cameras and all required parameters are finite
all resources required by the approved render-resource policy exist and match its provenance; recorded legacy resources excluded by the texture-agnostic policy may remain unavailable
rendered observation, evaluated Blender state, visibility evidence, and exported ground truth agree
all task inputs satisfy their eligibility and deadband rules
the authoritative contract, schema, render config, semantic baseline, and resource manifest versions are recorded

output_naming.overwrite_policy: never overwrite an existing generation run or sample directory; allocate a new generation_run_id
output_naming.version_change_policy: Any incompatible task, spatial, visibility, schema, or rendering change requires a new semantic version and output root.

rules: The task field is canonical; a natural-language question is optional.
Named semantic categories are not required for this ID-based first slice.
The confirmed texture-agnostic policy bypasses legacy object-material image nodes with one non-semantic neutral view-layer override; it does not claim original visual fidelity.
Ground truth must remain machine-readable in metadata.json and must not exist only in image_gt.png.
A failed or inconsistent sample is preserved as invalid evidence and is never silently repaired or relabeled valid.
